body.html: Jin Pool Villa Amnatcheroen, known locally as Jin Pool Villa, is a newer budget pool villa at 576 Moo 4, Chayangkun Road, in the Ban Khok Chakkachan area of Bung Subdistrict, Mueang Amnat Charoen district · Its clear selling point is being a villa with a saltwater pool and a focus on privacy, all at a rate in the low thousands of baht — something you rarely find in a small town like Amnat Charoen · It suits travellers who want a relaxed, pool-side feel rather than a block of identical hotel rooms.

There are several room types to match your group size · They run from a 6-foot bed room with a separate sitting area (about 40 sq.m), a double room with pool view (about 30 sq.m), through to large pool-view family rooms of 45–50 sq.m with king beds and a living area · The rooms are newly designed, simply and cleanly furnished — exactly what the reviews highlight · They give more usable space than a typical budget hotel and work well for a couple or a small family.
"A budget villa with new, clean rooms and a lovely design, plenty of privacy and a pool to swim in. Quiet and good value — perfect for a relaxed stay without paying a lot."

The heart of the place is the outdoor saltwater pool at the centre of the villa, which feels almost private · Saltwater is gentler on the skin than standard chlorine, and because it is a small property with few guests, the atmosphere stays quiet and private · There is free parking, free Wi-Fi in the common areas, 24-hour front-desk assistance and a self check-in system for late arrivals · It also has filtered drinking water, CCTV in common areas and daily housekeeping.

On location, Jin Pool Villa sits in the Ban Khok Chakkachan area on the edge of Amnat Charoen · It is only about 1.7–2.3 km from the town centre and the clock tower, a few minutes' drive to markets, restaurants and government offices · There is a gym (Consume the Iron) about 1.4 km away and Sarakhet Temple and other temples a short drive off · It is a spot that gives you the quiet of the outskirts while keeping the town easily reachable — ideal for self-drivers.

To be straight, per the real reviews: this is still a newer property with very few public reviews, so scores on some platforms come from just a handful of guests and are hard to read as a whole · It also has no breakfast or full restaurant service, and the Wi-Fi is focused on common areas — so if you expect big-hotel service with breakfast and staff on hand at all times, this is not it · But if the brief is a private, new pool villa at a low price, it answers it squarely.

In short, Jin Pool Villa Amnatcheroen suits couples or small families who want a private pool villa with new, clean rooms in the low thousands of baht · You get a saltwater pool, privacy, free parking and an outskirts location that is still easy to reach the town from · It is for travellers who want a quiet, pool-side break more than full town-hotel service · But because it is a newer property, it is worth comparing the latest photos and reviews across a few platforms before booking.

A tip from following the reviews here: if you are travelling as a group or family, choose the 45–50 sq.m pool-view family room with its separate sitting area — better value and more comfortable · Check-in is after 14:00 and check-out before 12:00; if you arrive late you can use self check-in, but let the property know in advance · And since there is no breakfast, pick up food beforehand or drive into town, which is only a few minutes away.
